cards.gloss_en: noisy or angry arguing
cards.ex_en: The children kept wrangling over the last piece of cake.
cards.ex_cn: 孩子们为最后一块蛋糕争吵个不停。

cards.gloss_en: bitter conflict or disagreement
cards.ex_en: The two families lived in constant strife.
cards.ex_cn: 两家人一直处于纷争之中。

cards.gloss_en: angry disagreement between people
cards.ex_en: There was much contention about who should lead.
cards.ex_cn: 关于谁来领导有很多争论。

cards.gloss_en: small precise details or distinctions
cards.ex_en: She explained the niceties of the rules to us.
cards.ex_cn: 她向我们讲解了规则的细微之处。

cards.gloss_en: in a very close or familiar way
cards.ex_en: The two friends knew each other intimately.
cards.ex_cn: 这两个朋友彼此非常熟悉。

cards.gloss_en: short swords worn at the side
cards.ex_en: The soldiers carried hangers on their belts.
cards.ex_cn: 士兵们腰带上挂着短剑。

cards.gloss_en: a short curved sword
cards.ex_en: He drew his hanger to defend himself.
cards.ex_cn: 他拔出短剑自卫。

cards.gloss_en: careful and cautious about consequences
cards.ex_en: She was circumspect when talking to strangers.
cards.ex_cn: 她跟陌生人说话时很谨慎。

cards.gloss_en: hiding the truth in order to trick others
cards.ex_en: His success was built on lies and deceit.
cards.ex_cn: 他的成功建立在谎言和欺骗之上。

cards.gloss_cn: 食物、口粮(victual 的口语变体)
cards.gloss_en: food or provisions
cards.ex_en: The travellers packed enough vittle for the road.
cards.ex_cn: 旅人们备足了路上的口粮。

cards.gloss_en: old form of 'know' used with 'thou'
cards.ex_en: Thou knowest the way home.
cards.ex_cn: 你知道回家的路。

cards.gloss_en: old form of 'say' used with 'thou'
cards.ex_en: Thou sayest the truth.
cards.ex_cn: 你说的是实话。

cards.gloss_cn: 黄颜木(一种可作染料的硬木)
cards.gloss_en: a tropical wood used to make yellow dye
cards.ex_en: They cut fustic to dye the cloth yellow.
cards.ex_cn: 他们砍黄颜木把布染成黄色。

cards.gloss_en: a small pole that stretches out a sail
cards.ex_en: The sail was held out by a wooden sprit.
cards.ex_cn: 帆被一根木制斜杠撑开。

cards.gloss_en: the main sail at the front of a ship
cards.ex_en: The wind filled the foresail and we moved fast.
cards.ex_cn: 风灌满前帆,我们行得飞快。

cards.gloss_en: clumsy and doing things badly
cards.ex_en: The bungling worker broke the machine again.
cards.ex_cn: 那笨手笨脚的工人又弄坏了机器。

cards.gloss_en: a person who builds or repairs ships
cards.ex_en: The shipwright spent months building the boat.
cards.ex_cn: 造船工匠花了几个月造这条船。

cards.gloss_en: too strong to be beaten
cards.ex_en: The champion felt invincible before the match.
cards.ex_cn: 冠军在比赛前觉得自己不可战胜。

cards.gloss_cn: 使振作、鼓舞(hearten 的过去式)
cards.gloss_en: made someone feel more hopeful
cards.ex_en: The good news heartened the tired team.
cards.ex_cn: 好消息鼓舞了疲惫的队伍。

cards.gloss_en: a large formal meal for many people
cards.ex_en: The king held a banquet for his guests.
cards.ex_cn: 国王为宾客举办了盛宴。

cards.gloss_en: careful watchfulness against danger
cards.ex_en: He approached the dog with great wariness.
cards.ex_cn: 他非常警惕地接近那条狗。

cards.gloss_en: a person from your own country
cards.ex_en: He was glad to meet a countryman abroad.
cards.ex_cn: 他在国外遇到同胞很高兴。

cards.gloss_en: lowest of all in position
cards.ex_en: The undermost box was crushed by the others.
cards.ex_cn: 最下面的箱子被其他箱子压坏了。

cards.gloss_en: in a way that makes you feel pity
cards.ex_en: The lost child cried piteously in the dark.
cards.ex_cn: 迷路的孩子在黑暗中可怜地哭着。

cards.gloss_cn: (古)心神狂乱的、痛苦得发狂的
cards.gloss_en: wild and frantic with grief or fear
cards.ex_en: She was almost distracted with worry for her son.
cards.ex_cn: 她为儿子担忧得几乎发狂。

cards.gloss_en: of a son or daughter toward a parent
cards.ex_en: He showed great filial love for his mother.
cards.ex_cn: 他对母亲表现出深厚的孝爱。

cards.gloss_en: rubbed to warm or to make sore
cards.ex_en: She chafed her cold hands by the fire.
cards.ex_cn: 她在火边搓着冰冷的双手。

cards.gloss_cn: 施魔法迷住(bewitch 的过去式)
cards.gloss_en: put under a magic spell
cards.ex_en: The music bewitched everyone in the hall.
cards.ex_cn: 那音乐迷住了大厅里的每个人。

cards.gloss_en: the upper edge of a boat's side
cards.ex_en: He gripped the gunnel as the boat rocked.
cards.ex_cn: 船摇晃时他抓紧了船舷上缘。

cards.gloss_en: the power or right to rule
cards.ex_en: The king held dominion over the whole land.
cards.ex_cn: 国王对整片土地拥有统治权。

cards.gloss_en: a person who makes laws for people
cards.ex_en: The ancient lawgiver wrote rules for the city.
cards.ex_cn: 那位古代立法者为城邦制定了法律。

cards.gloss_en: an animal that is one year old
cards.ex_en: The farmer sold a yearling at the market.
cards.ex_cn: 农夫在集市上卖了一头一岁的牲畜。

cards.gloss_en: ate an evening meal
cards.ex_en: We supped together by candlelight.
cards.ex_cn: 我们在烛光下一起吃了晚饭。

cards.gloss_cn: 抹去、消除(efface 的过去式)
cards.gloss_en: rubbed out or wiped away completely
cards.ex_en: Time had effaced the writing on the stone.
cards.ex_cn: 时间已把石头上的字迹抹去。

cards.gloss_en: existing as a natural part of something
cards.ex_en: Kindness seemed inherent in her nature.
cards.ex_cn: 善良似乎是她天性中固有的。

cards.gloss_en: a small sailing ship
cards.ex_en: They built a barque to cross the sea.
cards.ex_cn: 他们造了一条帆船渡海。

cards.gloss_en: a return made for a favour or wrong
cards.ex_en: He asked no requital for his kindness.
cards.ex_cn: 他为自己的善意不求任何回报。

cards.gloss_en: honesty and openness in speaking
cards.ex_en: She spoke of her mistakes with real candour.
cards.ex_cn: 她坦率地谈起自己的错误。

cards.gloss_en: innocent honesty and openness
cards.ex_en: The boy answered with childlike ingenuousness.
cards.ex_cn: 那男孩以孩子般的天真直率作答。

cards.gloss_en: to hate something very strongly
cards.ex_en: She abhors cruelty to animals.
cards.ex_cn: 她憎恶虐待动物。

cards.gloss_en: sacred religious ceremonies of the church
cards.ex_en: The priest performed the holy sacraments.
cards.ex_cn: 神父主持了神圣的圣礼。

cards.gloss_en: food and supplies for people
cards.ex_en: They stored enough victual for the winter.
cards.ex_cn: 他们储备了足够过冬的食物。

cards.gloss_en: sensible and worth doing
cards.ex_en: It is advisable to lock the door at night.
cards.ex_cn: 夜里锁门是明智的。

cards.gloss_en: to prepare land and grow crops on it
cards.ex_en: They cultivate rice in the wet fields.
cards.ex_cn: 他们在水田里种稻。

cards.gloss_en: coming at the right or useful time
cards.ex_en: His seasonable warning saved us from danger.
cards.ex_cn: 他及时的警告使我们避开了危险。

cards.gloss_en: to watch over work to see it is done right
cards.ex_en: She oversees the whole kitchen staff.
cards.ex_cn: 她监管着整个厨房的员工。

cards.gloss_en: an old gun fired by a spark
cards.ex_en: Each soldier carried a firelock and powder.
cards.ex_cn: 每个士兵都带着一把燧发枪和火药。

cards.gloss_cn: 配备人员于(man 的过去式)
cards.gloss_en: supplied with people to work or defend it
cards.ex_en: The fort was manned by twenty soldiers.
cards.ex_cn: 这座堡垒由二十名士兵驻守。

cards.gloss_en: to look down on with strong dislike
cards.ex_en: He despises people who tell lies.
cards.ex_cn: 他鄙视说谎的人。

cards.gloss_en: lower in rank or importance
cards.ex_en: Her wishes were subordinate to the group's needs.
cards.ex_cn: 她的意愿从属于集体的需要。

cards.gloss_en: in large amounts; more than enough
cards.ex_en: Fruit grew abundantly on the island.
cards.ex_cn: 岛上水果长得极为丰茂。

cards.gloss_en: a gentle but serious warning
cards.ex_en: He ignored his mother's admonition and got hurt.
cards.ex_cn: 他不听母亲的告诫,结果受了伤。

cards.gloss_en: an earnest and serious request
cards.ex_en: They listened to her tearful entreaty.
cards.ex_cn: 他们听着她含泪的恳求。

cards.gloss_en: the spending of too much money
cards.ex_en: His extravagance soon left him poor.
cards.ex_cn: 他的挥霍很快使他变穷。

cards.gloss_en: rude and showing no respect
cards.ex_en: The insolent boy talked back to his teacher.
cards.ex_cn: 那无礼的男孩顶撞老师。

cards.gloss_en: soft, wet and muddy
cards.ex_en: Our feet sank into the oozy riverbank.
cards.ex_cn: 我们的脚陷进湿软的河岸。

cards.gloss_en: wet loose sand that pulls things down
cards.ex_en: The traveller sank slowly into the quicksand.
cards.ex_cn: 那旅人慢慢陷入流沙。

cards.gloss_en: careful thinking about the future
cards.ex_en: With a little forethought we avoided the storm.
cards.ex_cn: 稍加谋划,我们便避开了风暴。

cards.gloss_cn: 闲逛、漫步(stroll 的过去式)
cards.gloss_en: walked slowly in a relaxed way
cards.ex_en: They strolled along the beach at sunset.
cards.ex_cn: 日落时他们沿海滩漫步。

cards.gloss_en: a person who shoots very accurately
cards.ex_en: The marksman hit the target every time.
cards.ex_cn: 那神射手每次都击中靶心。

cards.gloss_en: a ghost or frightening ghostly image
cards.ex_en: A pale spectre seemed to float down the hall.
cards.ex_cn: 一个苍白的幽灵仿佛飘过大厅。

cards.gloss_en: rough and lacking good manners
cards.ex_en: His uncouth manners shocked the guests.
cards.ex_cn: 他粗野的举止令宾客吃惊。

cards.gloss_en: harm or damage to someone's interests
cards.ex_en: He acted without prejudice to their rights.
cards.ex_cn: 他行事未损害他们的权利。

cards.gloss_en: to do what a rule or request asks
cards.ex_en: You must comply with the safety rules.
cards.ex_cn: 你必须遵守安全规定。

cards.gloss_en: a firm promise that something is true
cards.ex_en: He gave his assurance that the work was safe.
cards.ex_cn: 他保证这项工作是安全的。

cards.gloss_cn: 郑重声明、申辩(protestation 的复数)
cards.gloss_en: strong earnest declarations
cards.ex_en: Despite his protestations, no one believed him.
cards.ex_cn: 尽管他极力申辩,没人相信他。

cards.gloss_cn: 丧失、被没收(forfeit 的过去式)
cards.gloss_en: lost as a penalty for wrongdoing
cards.ex_en: He forfeited his prize by breaking the rules.
cards.ex_cn: 他因违规而丧失了奖品。

cards.gloss_en: a flag flown on a ship
cards.ex_en: The ship raised its ensign at dawn.
cards.ex_cn: 船在黎明时升起旗帜。

cards.gloss_en: a soldier who stands guard
cards.ex_en: A sentinel watched the gate all night.
cards.ex_cn: 一名哨兵整夜守着大门。

cards.gloss_en: the killing or wounding of people
cards.ex_en: The treaty ended years of bloodshed.
cards.ex_cn: 这项条约结束了多年的流血冲突。

cards.gloss_en: unable to decide what to do
cards.ex_en: He stood irresolute at the crossroads.
cards.ex_cn: 他在十字路口犹豫不决地站着。

cards.gloss_en: the leader of a group doing wrong
cards.ex_en: The police arrested the ringleader of the gang.
cards.ex_cn: 警方逮捕了这伙人的头目。

cards.gloss_en: having lost hope and energy
cards.ex_en: The dispirited team walked slowly off the field.
cards.ex_cn: 沮丧的球队慢慢走下球场。

cards.gloss_en: the commander of all a country's forces
cards.ex_en: The generalissimo led the whole army into battle.
cards.ex_cn: 大元帅率领全军投入战斗。

cards.gloss_en: to force into surrender or submission
cards.ex_en: The general reduced the rebel town after a siege.
cards.ex_cn: 将军围攻后迫使叛乱的城镇投降。

cards.gloss_en: to give up and accept an enemy's terms
cards.ex_en: The starving city was forced to capitulate.
cards.ex_cn: 饥饿的城市被迫投降。

cards.gloss_en: in a cruel and savage way
cards.ex_en: The prisoners were treated barbarously.
cards.ex_cn: 囚犯们受到残暴的对待。

cards.gloss_en: causing harm or damage
cards.ex_en: Smoking is injurious to your health.
cards.ex_cn: 吸烟有害健康。

cards.gloss_en: to plead with someone on another's behalf
cards.ex_en: She interceded with the judge for her brother.
cards.ex_cn: 她替弟弟向法官求情。

cards.gloss_en: a title of honour for a high official
cards.ex_en: The letter was addressed to His Excellency.
cards.ex_cn: 这封信是写给阁下的。

cards.gloss_en: spoken curses wishing harm on someone
cards.ex_en: He shouted wild imprecations at his enemies.
cards.ex_cn: 他向敌人狂喊着诅咒。

cards.gloss_en: troops stationed to defend a place
cards.ex_en: A small garrison defended the old fort.
cards.ex_cn: 一支小驻军守卫着那座旧堡垒。

cards.gloss_en: a large barrel for wine or water
cards.ex_en: They rolled a butt of wine into the cellar.
cards.ex_cn: 他们把一大桶酒滚进地窖。

cards.gloss_en: openings in a ship's deck
cards.ex_en: The sailors closed the hatches before the storm.
cards.ex_cn: 水手们在暴风雨前关上了舱口。

cards.gloss_en: iron fittings on a ship's side near the bow
cards.ex_en: He climbed up by the forechains to board the ship.
cards.ex_cn: 他攀着前系索铁链登上了船。

cards.gloss_cn: 夸脱(quart 的复数,液量单位)
cards.gloss_en: units of liquid each equal to two pints
cards.ex_en: The jug holds about two quarts of water.
cards.ex_cn: 这壶大约能装两夸脱水。
